title: Investigation of seasonal changes in flame retardant concentrations in car interiors
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00228A, Communication
Open Access

Petra Svobodová, Simona Rozárka Jílková, Jiří Kohoutek, Ondřej Audy, Lisa Melymuk
Seasonal changes in car interiors impact emission of flame retardants. Summer vehicle air showed higher levels, including TCEP concentrations nearly 700× higher than winter, pointing to strong seasonal release and inhalation risks.
